Amynta Group, through its PDP Group company, is hiring a Software Developer I to support enterprise applications and related systems. The role develops and maintains .NET-based applications, supports Azure Kubernetes Service environments and DB2 integrations, troubleshoots defects, and collaborates with technical and business teams under senior guidance.
Manufacturing
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Assist in developing and maintaining features within .NET-based web applications, according to business and technical specifications provided
Support application functionality deployed within Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments
Assist with integration and data exchange between DB2 databases and .NET applications
Troubleshoot and resolve basic application defects and support tickets
Write and maintain application code following established coding standards
Assist with testing, debugging, and validation of application changes
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior developers
Document application changes, configurations, and support procedures
Collaborate with QA, infrastructure, and business teams to understand requirements
Follow established SDLC, change management, and deployment processes
